title: Structure & Verification Layer — Knowledge Metabolism Pipeline (Layer 2 of Lily Pad)
summary: Complete Structure & Verification Layer for the Knowledge Metabolism System — tracks every knowledge artifact from mined→ported→tested→verified→deployed with YAML schema, status rollups, demand linking graph, lifecycle state machine, and audit trail
key_insights: VerificationItem schema (ver-YYYYMMDD-NNN.yaml) tracks knowledge through 7 lifecycle states with ZONEID integrity
Pipeline efficiency funnel (mined→ported→tested→verified→deployed) reveals bottlenecks per agent and per domain
Linking graph connects verification items to demand signals, knowledge signals, and git commits — traversable both directions
Lifecycle state machine has 18 valid transitions + 4 bypass rules (test-as-verification, hotfix express, simultaneous dock, clean room re-deploy)
Transition audit trail (JSONL in audit/) captures who changed what when for every status transition
7 seed items backfilled for existing deployed/verified knowledge (Master Synthesis, ZONEID constants, Lazy Deletion, 8-char names, Lily Pad design, Documentation Tracker, VR Vision)
